data.name: Hollywood Dreams & Los Angeles Highlights Tour Public
data.headline: Ready to See the Stars?
data.description: Experience the best of Los Angeles and Hollywood in one unforgettable day from San Diego! Visit Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Hollywood, and Downtown LA aboard a deluxe Five Star Tours coach with a professional bilingual guide.
data.highlights:
Visit 4 iconic Los Angeles destinations in one unforgettable day

Stroll the Santa Monica Pier, where Route 66 ends

Explore Beverly Hills & Rodeo Drive — luxury shops and celebrity landmarks

Experience the Hollywood Walk of Fame, TCL Chinese Theatre & Dolby Theatre

See the Hollywood Sign and take great photo stops

Discover Downtown Los Angeles landmarks like Walt Disney Concert Hall and Olvera Street

Enjoy lunch and shopping time at The Grove & Original Farmers Market

Travel in comfort aboard a deluxe Five Star Tours coach with air conditioning and bottled water

Learn from a professional bilingual guide sharing stories, fun facts, and local tips

Perfect for first-time visitors who want to see the best of LA in one day!
data.itinerary:
7:30 AM – Depart San Diego
Start your journey north along California’s beautiful coastline aboard our deluxe Five Star Tours coach. Short comfort stop en route.

10:00 AM – Santa Monica Pier & Beachfront Walk
Stroll the iconic pier where Route 66 ends, enjoy ocean views, and capture your first photos of the Pacific.

11:30 AM – Beverly Hills & Rodeo Drive
Drive through Beverly Hills, stop for a photo at the Beverly Hills Sign, and walk along Rodeo Drive’s luxury shops and palm-lined streets.

12:45 PM – Lunch at The Grove & Original Farmers Market
Enjoy lunch at one of LA’s most famous food destinations, offering everything from tacos to sushi and desserts. Restrooms and shaded seating available.

2:15 PM – Hollywood Boulevard & Walk of Fame
See the stars on Hollywood Boulevard, the TCL Chinese Theatre, and the Dolby Theatre — home of the Oscars — and take that must-have photo of the Hollywood Sign.

3:45 PM – Downtown Los Angeles Sightseeing
Drive through LA’s heart and pass major landmarks like:

Walt Disney Concert Hall

Los Angeles City Hall

El Pueblo de Los Ángeles (Olvera Street)

The Broad Museum & Grand Park

Enjoy a short walking stop at Olvera Street or Grand Central Market (depending on traffic and timing).

5:30 PM – Depart Los Angeles
Relax and enjoy the scenic drive back to San Diego. Quick comfort stop along the way.

8:30 PM – Arrive in San Diego
Drop-off at your original location — with unforgettable memories and a camera full of Hollywood moments!

data.faqs:
1. Where does the tour depart from?
The tour departs from central San Diego. Hotel pick-up is available from select locations. Your exact pick-up point and time will be confirmed 24 hours before your tour.

2. What time does the tour start and end?
Check-in is at 7:15 AM, and the tour departs at 7:30 AM sharp. Return to San Diego is approximately 8:30 PM.

3. How long is the tour?
The tour lasts about 12 hours, including travel time, sightseeing, and breaks.

4. What’s included in the tour price?
Round-trip deluxe transportation from San Diego, a professional bilingual guide, bottled water, and visits to Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Hollywood, and Downtown Los Angeles.

5. Are meals included?
Meals and beverages are not included. You’ll have free time for lunch at The Grove & Original Farmers Market, which offers a wide variety of dining options.

6. Is this tour suitable for children?
Yes! Families are welcome. The minimum age is 5 years old, but please note the tour lasts a full day (12 hours). All minors must be accompanied by an adult.

7. What kind of vehicle is used for the tour?
You’ll travel in a deluxe, air-conditioned coach operated by Five Star Tours — comfortable and ideal for long-distance travel.

8. Is the tour available in Spanish?
Yes, the tour is bilingual (English and Spanish). Your guide will provide commentary in both languages.

9. What happens if there is traffic or delays?
Los Angeles traffic can be unpredictable. We plan the route carefully, but timing for some stops may vary. Return time to San Diego may be slightly adjusted to ensure your comfort and safety.

10. What if I need to cancel or change my reservation?
All bookings are final. There are no refunds once your reservation is confirmed. In rare cases where weather, border delays, or unforeseen events prevent the tour from operating, you will be notified and receive a full refund.
